content.title: Essays on financial markets: aquaculture finance, energy transition, and intangible governance
content.abstract: This doctoral dissertation investigates the pricing, management, and mitigation of risk in modern financial markets, traversing the domains of natural resource economics, energy transition finance, and corporate governance. As the global economy enters an era of polycrisis defined by accelerating climate change, structural policy shifts, and complex agency conflicts, traditional valuation frameworks, which are often predicated on assumptions of linearity, stationarity, and limited dimensions, are increasingly insufficient.
